mapper.sql: FROM defect d LEFT JOIN users r ON r.id = d.reporter_id LEFT JOIN users a ON a.id = d.assignee_id LEFT JOIN test_execution e ON e.id = d.execution_id LEFT JOIN test_case tc ON tc.id = e.test_case_id LEFT JOIN test_cycle c ON c.id = e.cycle_id
SELECT d.*, r.name AS reporter_name, a.name AS assignee_name, tc.id AS test_case_id, tc.tc_code, tc.title AS tc_title, c.id AS cycle_id, c.cycle_no, c.name AS cycle_name

where.if: AND (LOWER(d.title) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(d.defect_code) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')))

mapper.select: ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect (project_id, defect_code, title, description, severity, priority, status, reporter_id, assignee_id, execution_id) VALUES (#{projectId}, (SELECT CONCAT('DF-', LPAD(CAST(COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(defect_code, 4) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 4, '0')) FROM defect WHERE project_id = #{projectId}), #{title}, #{description}, #{severity}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{reporterId}, #{assigneeId}, #{executionId})
mapper.update: UPDATE defect SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, severity = #{severity}, priority = #{priority}, assignee_id = #{assigneeId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE defect SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect_comment (defect_id, author_id, content, status_from, status_to) VALUES (#{defectId}, #{authorId}, #{content}, #{statusFrom}, #{statusTo})
mapper.select: SELECT dc.*, u.name AS author_name FROM defect_comment dc LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = dc.author_id WHERE dc.defect_id = #{defectId} ORDER BY dc.created_at, dc.id
